scenes.name: 3 AM Midnight Reverie
scenes.subtitle: Late night study session • 3 AM hostel room reflections

scenes.name: Unfinished Formulas in the Margin
scenes.subtitle: Calculations incomplete in the margins • Tired ink on fingertips

lines.text: Kitaabon ke kore margin pe, kitne hisaab adhoore hain,
Ungli pe ink ke daagh liye, khwaab abhi kya poore hain?

scenes.name: The Silence at 3 AM
scenes.subtitle: Staring at the wall at 3 AM • Writing resolve in the margin

lines.text: Chashme ke peechhe thaki nazar, deewaron ko takti rehti hai,
Raat ke teen baje yeh khamoshi, sau sawaal mujhse kehti hai.
Haan panno ke is jungle mein, gum hai mera thikaana,
Kore margin pe likh ke rakha: haar ke nahi hai jaana.

scenes.name: Homesick Silence & Cello Swell
scenes.subtitle: Acoustic interlude • Remembering Mom's care package

scenes.name: Mom's Call & Lukewarm Chai
scenes.subtitle: Mom's voice on the receiver • Lukewarm chai and unyielding expectations

lines.text: Maa ne kaha tha phone pe kal, "Beta tu thoda aaraam bhi kar,"
Kaise bataun usse yahan, har lamha lagta hai ek safar.
Steel ke dabbe ka aakhri laddoo, ghar ki mitti yaad dilaaye,
Pita ki mehnat ka socha toh, neendein aana bhool hi jaayein.
Table pe thandi hoti chai, panno pe pehra deti hai,
Har galat calculation pe, umeed chupke se roti hai.

scenes.name: Mukhda Reprise
scenes.subtitle: Re-anchoring the heart • Refusing to yield

lines.text: Kitaabon ke kore margin pe, kitne hisaab adhoore hain,
Kore margin pe likh ke rakha: haar ke nahi hai jaana.

scenes.name: The Notice Board & Rising from Zero
scenes.subtitle: Beyond percentiles and ranks • Rising stubbornly from zero

lines.text: Notice board ke us kaghaz par, roll number ek bheed sa hai,
Koi na jaane uske peechhe, zakhm koi ummeed sa hai.
Yeh test, yeh marks, yeh rank-list, meri hadd tay nahi karegi,
Meri koshishon ki aag kabhi, is darr ke aage na daregi.
Main sifar se uth kar aaya hoon, aasmaan tak jaana hai,
Gir kar sambhalna seekha hai, khud ko yeh samjhaana hai.

scenes.name: The Dawn Breaks & Perspective Reversal
scenes.subtitle: The dark hour lifts • It's just an exam, not life itself

lines.text: Khidki ke baahar dheere dheere, andhera ab chhat-ne laga,
Chidiya ki pehli chahak se, man ka darr kat-ne laga.
Ek imtehaan hi toh hai yeh, zindagi toh nahi hai na...
Abhi toh poori subah baaqi hai, hausla chhodna nahi hai na!

scenes.name: Fierce Hope & Full Release
scenes.subtitle: Peak dynamic release • Writing fierce hope upon the page

lines.text: Kitaabon ke kore margin pe, ab darr nahi umeed likhi hai,
Ungli pe ink ke daagh sahi, par manzil ki daleel likhi hai.
Haan panno ke is jungle se, raasta naya banana hai,
Kore margin pe likh ke rakha: haar ke nahi hai jaana!

scenes.name: Sunrise Awakening & Lingering Hope
scenes.subtitle: Morning sun illuminates the desk • The journey continues

lines.text: Haan haar ke nahi jaana...
Kore margin pe...
Suraj ko aana hoga...
